secrets.name: EXPO_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL
secrets.description: Optional. Supabase project URL for the mobile app (staging: symsotzagpwzmiyawkpm). Without it the app runs on its seeded offline demo data.

secrets.name: EXPO_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_PUBLISHABLE_KEY
secrets.description: Optional. Publishable key (sb_publishable_...) for the mobile app. Must be supplied together with the URL.

secrets.name: NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL
secrets.description: Optional. Supabase project URL for the admin website/console on port 3001. Without it that service uses its built-in demo data.

secrets.name: NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_PUBLISHABLE_KEY
secrets.description: Optional. Publishable key for the admin service; must be supplied together with its URL.

secrets.name: SUPABASE_SECRET_KEY
secrets.description: Optional server-only key used by the admin background workers. Not needed for the demo-mode preview.
